fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects DNS queries to a TeamViewer domain only resolved by a TeamViewer client by an image that isn't named TeamViewer (sometimes used by threat actors for obfuscation)
fields.name: TeamViewer Domain Query By Non-TeamViewer Application
fields.query: event.category="dns" and (endpoint.os="windows" and ((event.dns.request in ("taf.teamviewer.com","udp.ping.teamviewer.com")) and (not src.process.image.path contains "TeamViewer")))
